description.value: Craig Street Brew Pub is a locally rooted craft brewery and full-service restaurant that has anchored downtown Duncan since 2006, housed in a cedar-beamed space with high ceilings and vintage West Coast character. Cyclists can watch new batches being brewed from the dining room, and the kitchen focuses on Cowichan Valley ingredients — house nachos, pear salads, and taco salads among the popular eats. It is the flagship of a small family of Cowichan Valley venues, making it a natural hub for riders exploring the valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and confirms the business is an active brew pub, microbrewery, and restaurant at 25 Craig Street, Duncan, BC, operating since 2006. The phone number (250) 737-2337 and address are confirmed on the website, though neither appears in OSM tags. No bike-specific amenities (racks, parking, pump, Wi-Fi, or takeout) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields must remain null per evidence rules.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number or street address; both were sourced from the website only.
No bike parking or cyclist-specific amenities confirmed; a site visit or direct contact would strengthen the listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An established full-service pub and microbrewery in central Duncan since 2006 — a logical stop for touring cyclists on the Cowichan Valley corridor, pending confirmation of bike parking.
enrichment_extras.notes: Craig Street Brew Pub is the flagship location of the CShg Family group, which also operates Just Jakes, Jakes at the Lake, The Oak Taphouse, and Red Arrow Brewing — all potentially relevant to a cycling directory covering the Cowichan Valley.
